outcome: Expression of contraction-associated proteins (CAPs) including connexin 43 (Cx43), oxytocin receptors (OXR), prostaglandin receptors EP1, EP3, FP, and protease-activated receptor (PAR)-1
cohort: 38 subjects with PAM selected from an amniotic fluid embolism registry (2011-2018) and 10 control parturients who underwent cesarean section.
finding: The immunostaining-positive areas of Cx43, OXR, EP1, EP3, and FP were significantly smaller in the PAM group compared to the control group, whereas those of PAR-1 and Na+/K+-ATPase increased significantly in the PAM group.
